rules.problem: Digital skills are insufficiently embedded across roles.
rules.why_it_matters: A manufacturing SME's transformation depends on people being able to use and improve connected systems.
rules.suggested_action: Create a structured digital skills programme.
rules.first_step: Map required digital skills by role and identify critical capability gaps.
rules.kpi: Percentage of relevant employees completing training modules.
rules.required_resources: Training budget, line managers, learning plan

rules.problem: Production data is not consistently monitored in real time.
rules.why_it_matters: Without live monitoring, issues are detected too late and improvements are harder to sustain.
rules.suggested_action: Pilot real-time monitoring on one production line.
rules.first_step: Select a critical process, define KPIs, and implement dashboards and alerts.
rules.kpi: Percentage of critical process parameters monitored in real time.

rules.problem: Industrial cybersecurity practices are incomplete or fragmented.
rules.why_it_matters: Connected production environments need baseline controls to protect people, data, and continuity.
rules.suggested_action: Implement an industrial cybersecurity baseline covering identity, access control, network segmentation, patching, backups, and response plans.
rules.first_step: Assess current exposure and define a minimum baseline for shop-floor systems.
rules.kpi: Percentage of critical assets covered by formal cybersecurity controls.
rules.required_resources: Security assessment, access controls, segmentation plan, backups
